This is the build-only snapshot of O6lvl4/uimodulay used by this portfolio.
It includes the locally developed fit renderer and oghma template as of 2026-09-19,
which were not yet committed in the upstream checkout (base 49680447135f25c42093c3afb09acaf52af583a5).
Keeping it here makes scheduled builds independent of the author's working directory.
